source_note: WMATA publishes timetables and a trip planner at this URL. This build had no access to it, so every minute below is a hand-estimated approximation of typical Silver Line running time from Wiehle-Reston East. Treat each as 'about N min'. Replace with timetable values and set verified true when checked.

home_access.note: Home to Wiehle is about 1.5 mi, too far to walk comfortably, so it is driven or biked. Drive time comes from OSRM; parking is not modelled.

transfer_note: Farragut North, Dupont Circle, Gallery Place, Judiciary Square and Union Station: Silver Line to Metro Center, then Red Line, with about 4 min added for the transfer. Archives: transfer at L'Enfant Plaza, about 4 min added.
